title: He is, She is, It is
hook_voice: Lesson six. He is, she is, it is.
hook_say: Inglizchada u uchun uch xil so'z bor!

example.en: He is my friend. He is happy.

end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga yettinchi dars: biz, siz, ular.
caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 6-dars: inglizcha «He is, She is, It is».

He is a doctor — U shifokor
She is happy — U xursand
It is a book — Bu kitob

He — erkak, she — ayol, it — narsa yoki hayvon haqida.
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 7-dars: Biz, siz, ular.
